Nandan Nilekani panel suggests AI for last-minute exam papers to curb leaks

A panel headed by Nandan Nilekani is exploring the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to generate question papers at the last minute as a potential solution to prevent exam leaks. The proposal aims to address the issue of paper leaks by making it difficult to obtain question papers in advance.
